items.title: Return address certification form
items.quote:
Please complete the enclosed address certification and mail or upload it by January 15,
2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date in plain English ('by January 15, 2027') for mailing or uploading the completed address certification. This is a foreign commercial bank, not a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery or §§187-193 BGB counting rules apply; the date is taken as printed. January 15, 2027 is a Friday, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed even if such rules were applied.

warnings: This is an unsolicited letter from a foreign (US) bank asking a customer to submit personal address/identity documents under threat of account restriction — a pattern also used in phishing; verify authenticity by contacting the bank through a phone number or website you already know, not any contact details printed on this letter, before sending any documents or using any enclosed form/link.
The letter gives no IBAN or payment instructions itself, but any 'enclosed' form that asks for bank login details or payment should be treated with suspicion.
No German deemed-delivery rules were applied because the sender is a US company, not a German authority; the due date is taken exactly as printed in the letter.
